criterionAssessments.rationale: Freshsales is marketed as an easy-to-use AI sales CRM with kanban pipelines and decluttered sales views aimed at SMB adoption.
Kanban view, lifecycle stages, deal insights (Pro+), and pipeline growth messaging are core first-party strengths.
Basic workflows on Growth plus sequences/territories on Pro and broader automation/AI assistance are well documented.
Email templates and multi-channel engagement (chat/email/phone) are documented; sequences deepen on Pro+.
Insights, deal insights, and Enterprise forecasting insights support sales management reporting needs.
Custom fields across plans; Enterprise adds custom modules, field-level permissions, sandbox, and audit logs.
Freshworks ecosystem and marketplace messaging support stack connectivity; less of a standalone “500+ apps” story than Pipedrive.
SMB-friendly defaults, but Pro/Enterprise governance and Freddy/add-on choices add admin surface.
Enterprise packaging targets mid/large teams with sandbox, permissions, and forecasting depth.
Growth at $9/user/mo annual is one of the strongest documented entry prices among researched sales CRMs, with a full 21-day trial.

overallScoreRationale: Equal-weight average across CRM methodology criteria, grounded in live first-party research. Not a hands-on lab score.
